summary: Warren should retain a standalone municipal control row. Official City of Warren police pages, Ohio Attorney General directory entries, and Trumbull County Sheriff materials show Warren Police Department remains the city's primary general-law-enforcement agency while the sheriff's road division serves county townships rather than replacing city policing. Warren also maintains official police annual reports through 2023 plus a live crime-activity map, and the official FBI 2024 agency roster still lists OH0780700 as Warren Police Department with is_nibrs true. The current 2024 full-fill state is therefore a reporting and publication continuity failure on a valid municipal target, not a county replacement, merged-service, or invalid-target case. Exact blocker: no reviewed public 2024 annual offense table was located, and Warren's own 2020-2023 annual-report UCR Part 1 totals differ materially from the repo's federal/state-derived counts, so any direct repair requires an explicit city-vs-federal reconciliation step rather than automatic backfill.
